title: Delivery and platform practice
summary: How work is scoped, written down, piloted and turned into a platform others use: the forward-deployed delivery model, scoping and design docs, ADRs, workflow mapping, pilots, golden paths, reusable tooling.
intro: This module covers how work is scoped, written down, piloted and turned into a platform that others use. It includes the forward deployed delivery model from signed scope to go-live, technical scoping and design docs, architecture decision records, mapping customer workflows to choose what to automate, and proofs of concept with measurable success criteria. It also treats the platform as a product, with golden paths and self-service templates, and shows how one-off customer builds become reusable platform features and internal tooling.
